# Everything runtime

Qing Launcher bundles these fixed official voidtools components:

- Everything 1.4.1.1032 x64 English (portable)
- Everything command-line interface (ES) 1.1.0.37 x64
- Everything SDK `Everything64.dll` (IPC wrapper)

- https://www.voidtools.com/License.txt
